Pamphlets should be used when you want to give people more information than you can put on a poster.

Pamphlets can:
  • explain an issue to the community like health and wellness
  • inform people of their rights
  • win support for a cause
Pamphlets are a simple way of providing information.
We use should to make suggestions and give advice:
Example: You should have an eye examination.
We use could to make suggestions:
Example: We could meet after the appointment.
You use should for advice in the present and in the past.
You use modal verbs might, may and could + an infinitive form when you think something is possible.

• might / might not + infinitive
  • could / could not + infinitive
  • may / may not + infinitive
  • can / can't + infinitive

images.text: No one should take their sight for granted. Can you imagine a world without colors?  In fact, some people cannot see certain colors. They have a condition that is called achromatopsia, or color-blindness. Color-blind people are usually born with the problem, but sometimes it may develop later.

Total color-blindness in people is very rare and is caused when certain parts of the eye, called cones, do not work properly. Usually, only some of the cones do not work. Then the person cannot tell the difference between red and green.

There is no cure for color-blindness despite modern medical technology, but color-blind people have no problem living a normal life. They might have trouble driving, since they cannot tell the difference between the colors of traffic lights. They have to learn to remember that the red light is at the top and the green one is at the bottom. Recently, companies have developed new technology that allows sufferers to see some color with special lenses.
One advantage that color-blind people do have over others is that they can see hidden objects and animals better than other people. There have even been cases when certain armies hired color-blind people to find hidden enemies. What advice would you give someone trying to hide from a person with color-blindness? You should  definitely choose a good hiding place!
